title: fix(objectql, plugin-audit): bound a held session lock's probe, unlock and close so a stalled connection cannot hang the sealer or --apply
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6bxiPKCvVuzoFTExumbxoz)_
Fixes #33932
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:运维人员跑审计封存的数据改写命令、或服务器做审计封存时,数据库连接卡死不再让进程永远挂住;约十秒后放弃,并按“锁已丢失”报错退出。
- 为什么做:审计封存锁(防止封存与数据改写同时进行)这条线上的收尾问题,由上一张封存锁卡的评审提出。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是把一个很慢但还活着的连接误判为锁丢失,命令报错并提示运行审计校验,结果偏保守;改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The card's acceptance, verbatim:

> - A stalled connection cannot hang `finish()`. The probe, the release and the close each time out, and a timed-out probe reads as a lost lock: the run reports the lost session at error, names `os audit verify`, and exits non-zero, as an ended session does today.
> - A pin with a fake connection that never answers proves each leg is bounded, and an ablation turns the pin red.
> - The schema-migration lock keeps its statements and behaviour unless the change is declared.

- `packages/objectql/src/database-session-lock.ts`: a held lock's three finishing steps each race a 10 s bound (`DATABASE_SESSION_LOCK_ANSWER_MS`, exported from the module only, not from the package entry):
  - `isHeld()`: a `select 1` not answered in time reads `false` (lost), and the session is marked stalled, so it is never probed again.
  - `release()`: the unlock statement is bounded. After a stalled probe no unlock is sent at all: the connection is closed, which releases the lock.
  - close (`destroyRawConnection`): bounded, for every caller of the shared close.
  - A live session is unchanged: same statements, no wait, and no timer left behind (`vi.getTimerCount()` is 0 after a live probe and release).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/seal-lock.ts`: docs on `finish()`, and the lost-lock line now reads `(its database session ended, or stopped answering)`. The CLI path is unchanged. `underAuditSealLock` returns the line as `lostLock`, and each `os migrate audit-*` command prints it with `printError` and calls `this.exit(1)`. `audit-redaction-seal.contract.test.ts` already pins that exit.
- The sealer pass needed no change. Its lock cover calls the same `isHeld()` (in `lapsed()` before each checkpoint) and `release()` (in its `finally`), so both are bounded now.
- One changeset: `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, both `patch`.

**Declared change to the schema-migration lock (card item 3).** The bound lives in the shared module, so `acquireSchemaMigrationLock`'s `release()` is bounded too. Its statements are byte-identical, and the existing `schema-migration-lock.test.ts` statement pins pass unchanged. A live session behaves as before. The only change: a release on a session that has stopped answering returns after the bound instead of hanging `os migrate apply` or the boot's schema sync. The advisory lock then stays with that database session until the connection dies, as it would if the process had been killed. The migration lock never calls `isHeld()`.

I did not make the bound opt-in from the seal-lock caller. That needs a new field on the exported `DatabaseSessionLockRunOptions` (or on `DatabaseSessionLock`), which widens `@objectstack/objectql`'s published surface and would make `Clause-②` yes (widening), against the claim. Bounding every holder keeps every exported signature unchanged.

## Tests

<details><summary>Premise re-measured with a never-answering fake, before the fix (origin/main ca4ec2a2f1)</summary>

The new `database-session-lock.test.ts` block, run against the unfixed module: 7 failed | 19 passed. The 6 stall pins each read `'still waiting'` after the bound (probe, unlock and close never settle). The 7th failure is the constant pin, which reads `undefined`. The live-path pin passed.

</details>

New pins:
- `packages/objectql/src/database-session-lock.test.ts`, new describe `a stalled session never hangs its holder`, on fake timers:
  - probe (postgres and mysql): still waiting at bound minus 1 ms, `false` at the bound, never re-sent;
  - stalled probe then release: no unlock is sent, and the close is bounded;
  - unlock (postgres and mysql): bounded, then the session is closed;
  - close: bounded;
  - live path: unchanged statements, zero timers left.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-seal/audit-seal-lock.test.ts`, new describe `a stalled connection cannot hang the hold's finish or a sealer pass`:
  - `finish()` on a stalled session resolves `{ lost: true }` with the line naming `os audit verify`, and no unlock is sent;
  - a sealer pass whose session stalls mid-pass returns 0, writes no checkpoint, and reports `the audit seal lock on the database of 'sys_audit_log' lapsed`.

Results, all on head 6262e609ac:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 619 passed (619), Tests 13986 passed (13986). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: Test Files 103 passed (103), Tests 1726 passed (1726). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck`: both exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` OK on both.

## Acceptance notes

- After a close times out, the half-open socket is left to the OS. Destroying it needs per-dialect client internals (pg `stream.destroy()`, mysql2 `destroy()`) that knex does not expose on `destroyRawConnection`. On the `--apply` path the command exits through oclif's `process.exit`, so the process does not linger.
- Bounding the acquire path (try-lock, marker, `heldAmong`, the wait) is not in this card.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablations: one per leg, each with on-disk proof (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs) and restore proof (blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

objectql suite (imports `src/`, so no build is in the loop):
- probe leg: `withinAnswerTime(run('select 1 as held'))` changed to the bare `run(...)`. 3 failed: both probe pins, plus the stalled-probe-then-release pin.
- unlock leg: the bound removed from the unlock. 2 failed: both unlock pins.
- close leg: the bound removed from `destroyRawConnection`. 2 failed: the close pin and the stalled-probe-then-release pin.
- The first run of the probe and unlock legs got `exit 99` (queue-timeout) and measured nothing. Both were re-run.

plugin-audit suite (resolves `@objectstack/objectql` through its `dist/`, a `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` pair):
- Mutation: `Promise.race([step, stalled])` changed to the bare step. objectql rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` confirmed the marker present in 2 built files. 2 failed: both new seal-lock pins.
- The first attempt used a comment marker, which tsup strips. The preflight refused it (marker absent from dist), so that run measured nothing and the leg was re-run with a code marker.
- Restore leg: objectql rebuilt, `--absent` preflight: marker absent from all 14 built files. Both suites green again.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, narrowed to this diff), head 6262e609ac</summary>

- 69 derived, 69 run. 67 exited 0.
- 2 are NOT MEASURED, exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need the whole repo built): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`. Neither reads a file this diff changes, and CI runs both on a full build.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: 69 accounted, 67 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED derived from the recorded exit 3, 0 unrun.
- `overlap-check` against origin/main d1ebe86dd3: merges cleanly.

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/database-session-lock.test.ts`. Expect 26 passed. Then delete `withinAnswerTime(...)` around `select 1 as held` and re-run: the two probe pins and the stalled-probe-then-release pin go red.

Read first:
1. `database-session-lock.ts`, the `held()` hunk: the `stalled` flag and the skipped unlock.
2. `database-session-lock.ts`, `withinAnswerTime`: its timer is cleared in `finally`.
3. `audit-seal-lock.test.ts`, the sealer-pass pin.
